title: Launch journal and audience-tagged changelog review workflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build an auditable, audience-aware process for drafting, reviewing, and publishing launch communications and changelogs. The workflow should produce: 1) an internal launch journal (timeline, decisions, rollbacks, owner matrix); 2) a customer-facing changelog where entries are tagged by audience tier (Developer, Platform, Enterprise) and by impact level; 3) a short exec summary and a staged notification plan (email, in-product, release notes page). This ticket coordinates PM responsibilities, design phrasing and screenshots, engineering impact verification, legal redaction guidance, and translation handoff. We will also capture a minimal machine-readable metadata header for each changelog entry to support future automation (but not implementing the automation in this ticket).
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical launch journal doc exists and is linkable from the release page
Changelog draft contains entries with audience tags and impact level for every customer-facing change
Cross-functional reviewers (Eng/Design/Security/Legal/CS) have provided signoff or documented objections
Rollout plan lists channel, schedule, and rollback criteria; notification copy prepared for Developer and Enterprise tiers
Localization request created and handoff to localization vendor scheduled

draft_snippet: [Developer] Improved streaming API resilience: added automatic backpressure handling for long-running streams (impact: medium). Migration: update client to retry with exponential backoff (sample snippet included). [Enterprise] Notes: No data model changes; recommend account teams validate SLA expectations.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Internal launch journal published to internal docs and #launch-readiness Slack (T-2 days). Stage 2: Developer blog and Dev docs update (T+0). Stage 3: Tiered customer email: Enterprise customers only (T+1), broader customer digest (T+3). Stage 4: Web release notes page updated and localized content staged (T+3 to T+7). Rollback criteria: increase in 5xx rate > 1.5x baseline or streaming error rate > 2% sustained for 30m.
